name: 16501 · Erie, PA
findings: ZIP 16501 (Erie) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16501 (Erie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16501 (Erie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44.5 times the typical level).
